errors.text: The proposed 1050 °C/5 min SPS cycle lies outside the target 900–1000 °C/10 min window and omits the target vacuum environment and 20:1 ball-to-powder ratio.
No quantitative strain or displacement rate is defined; describing rapid thermal expansion and contraction as a high sintering strain rate does not satisfy the requested processing constraint.
The mechanism repeatedly invokes Nb segregation and Nb-rich Laves phases even though the nominal CoCrFeNiTi alloy contains no Nb.

The predicted grain size, phase fraction, hardness, and density do not reproduce the target outcomes: <500 nm, <10% BCC, >300 HV, and <1% porosity are substantially different from <48 nm, 17% BCC, 675 HV, and density >6.5 g/cm³.
The proposed 500 g indentation differs by roughly an order of magnitude from the target 0.05 kN test and does not independently separate Hall–Petch strengthening from solid-solution strengthening.
